description: Make a link a client opens without an account to see the design screens of a builder app, comment on them and approve the design or ask for changes. Returns the url to send them. label names the link (for example the client); days = how long it stays open (1 to 90, default 30). The page shows the workspace's approval page look (name, color, logo, set in the dashboard). Tell the person first and pass confirm: true. Developer role. Pro and Team; open links per app depend on the plan.

label.description: Name of the link, for example "Sarah at Bean There"

name: create_builder_approval_link
title: Make a client approval link for a builder design
